name: Token dilution

subjectOf.text: Because newly minted reward tokens go only to agents who stake tokens on policies, passive holders are diluted over time, which pushes agents toward active underwriting while still permitting passive investment.
subjectOf.abstract: Thus, the total number of tokens grows over time. This implies that "passive" agents who hold the tokens purely to receive a share of future premia will find their proportional ownership in the DAO decrease over time.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
scope_conditions: reward tokens minted per policy underwritten

subjectOf.text: Because the total supply of tokens grows at a constant rate each period, the value of individual tokens depreciates over time.
subjectOf.abstract: Note that as the total number of tokens is growing at a rate of ρ per period, the value of individual tokens will depreciate over time.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Decentralized Underwriting (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396542
scope_conditions: token supply growing at rate rho per period
